items.title: Chico Hamilton — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: The interviewer mentions Pops Collette in relation to Buddy Collette; the interviewee (Chico Hamilton) does not mention Pops Collette or claim any personal interaction with him.

ctx.x: Yeah, Buddy. Well Buddy even today -- Buddy’s always been conservative. I mean, not so much that he’s cool but he’s very conservative, but I guess you would call that cool too, you know, laid back but -­
Yeah, well, you know, Mingus talks a lot about Pops Collette, you know, hanging out at Buddy’s house and knowing his dad.

Buddy was the first one of us young guys, first of all to be successful, man. He had a car, bought a brand new Pontiac. You know, when we were still in our teens, you know, he had a gig. He worked with C.P. Johnson, big band. You know, Buddy was making big dough. Buddy’s always been successful as a musician, you know.
